title: Four new heavyweight text models joined the API
summary:
A model-heavy day: four new text models, more direct provider routes, a rebuilt Enter management flow, and docs aligned with production.

The unified text API gained GLM-5.3 FlashX, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Sol and Luna. The new lineup covers long-context and multimodal work: GLM and Opus support 1M-token contexts, Opus includes adaptive thinking and automatic tools, and the GPT-6 models arrive through OpenAI's Responses API with explicit context-tier support.

Wan and Qwen models now prefer direct Alibaba routes while retaining existing providers as fallbacks, bringing Alibaba context and cache tiers to supported Qwen text models. Mistral Large 3 fallbacks now go directly to Mistral as well, and seeded requests are translated for upstream compatibility instead of wandering into a 422.

The Enter interface now unifies sign-in, authorization, device approval, API-key management, top-ups, and error handling. Models, Agents, and MCP catalog tabs are back with consistent forms, permissions, confirmations, and layouts that keep long configuration screens inside the viewport.
